description: This file defines a dialog component named 'textarea' within the CKEditor rich text editor. It handles the UI and behavior for inserting and editing <textarea> elements via the CKEDITOR.dialog API, including setup, content management, and validation for attributes like name, cols, and rows.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Register a new dialog named 'textarea' with CKEditor, defining its UI and behavior.

methods.name: onShow
methods.description: Prepares the dialog for display, retrieves the selected textarea element if any, and loads its attributes.

methods.name: onOk
methods.description: Handles the insertion or update of the textarea element into the editor based on dialog inputs.

methods.name: setupContent
methods.description: Populates dialog fields based on the selected textarea element's current attributes.

methods.name: commitContent
methods.description: Applies the data from dialog inputs back to the textarea element's attributes.
